result.reason: The redline adds the required six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, machine-readable data export, deletion, and written certification. However, data export is required only within 30 days after Customer requests it, rather than within 30 days after expiry or termination, so it does not fully reach the preferred position. The change is otherwise targeted, preserves the existing payment terms, and is professionally drafted, though deletion has no express completion deadline.
